beats.vo: Arjun is twenty-four. First job in Bengaluru. He put one lakh rupees into Bitcoin — at the worst possible moment. He just did not know it yet.
By June, Bitcoin had fallen twenty-nine percent — from seventy-eight lakh to fifty-five and a half lakh rupees. His one lakh became seventy-one thousand.
Gold had barely moved. The stock market barely dipped. Everyone online said the same thing: sell before it goes to zero. Arjun opened the app forty times a day.

He did not sell. Not because he was brave — because he remembered three rules. Rule one: only invest what you can watch drop by thirty percent. Rule two: crypto is a ten-year bet, not a ten-day bet. Rule three: never check the price more than once a day.
He did nothing. That was the whole move. Months passed — the calendar flipped — and Bitcoin climbed back to seventy-four lakh rupees. His seventy-one thousand became ninety-five thousand.
His one lakh is not back to one lakh — it is still down five percent. But he learned the only lesson that matters: panic sells at the bottom. Patience gets paid at the top. Follow for the next story.
